theorems.name: Submission.ted_lpm_am_cutoff_sequence
theorems.statement: ∀ ε₁ : ℝ, 0 < ε₁ → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k, 0 < ε k ∧ ε k ≤ ε₁) ∧ Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (φ k)) ∧ (∀ k, Antitone (φ k)) ∧ (∀ k s, 0 ≤ φ k s ∧ φ k s ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ k s, s ≤ 1 → φ k s = 1) ∧ (∀ k s, 1 + ε k ≤ s → φ k s = 0) ∧ (∀ s, 1 < s → ∀ᶠ k in atTop, φ k s = 0)
